operating_margin.basis: Operating income 12,019,000 EUR divided by revenue 162,019,000 EUR, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 31,678,000 EUR less capex 27,861,000 EUR, divided by revenue 162,019,000 EUR, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt -27,903,000 EUR (total debt 4,990,000 less cash 32,893,000, as of 2025-12-31; a net cash position) divided by an EBITDA proxy 52,217,000 EUR (operating income 12,019,000 plus depreciation 40,198,000 for the period ended 2025-12-31), from the yfinance-statements series. Both debt and cash are reported in the statement currency (EUR), so this leverage ratio does not depend on the EUR/SEK trading-currency mismatch that blocks the valuation group below.
